title: Blow-ups of (0,1) × M are integrals of blow-ups of M over the rescaled interval
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], Φ(s, u) := (s, u_1, …, u_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ u))), π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))), y₀ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y) 0, and assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A), where Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2) on ℝ × ℝ^P and L¹ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Hᵐ-null-measurable and countably m-rectifiable with Hᵐ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Hᵐ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K, x ∈ ℝ^P, s₀ ∈ ℝ, f : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ continuous with compact support, and r > 0. Put y* := Φ(s₀, x), M̃ := {y : π(y) ∈ M ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)} and a_r(σ) := ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' M} f(Φ(σ, w))·θ(x + r·w) dHᵐ(w). Then ∫_{blowUpMap y* r '' M̃} f(z)·θ(π(y* + r·z)) dH^{m+1}(z) = ∫_ℝ 1_{(−s₀/r, (1−s₀)/r]}(σ)·a_r(σ) dσ.
